en.headline: Tour bus driver dies after collapsing in Shing Mun Tunnel; 47 children unhurt
en.dek: A 71-year-old driver lost consciousness while ferrying schoolchildren from Sha Tin toward Tsuen Wan; the vehicle struck a barrier and he later died in hospital.
body: A 71-year-old tour-bus driver died after collapsing at the wheel inside the Shing Mun Tunnel on Wednesday afternoon. The bus, carrying 47 young children and a female attendant, struck a roadside barrier in the tube heading toward Tsuen Wan.

Police received reports at about 3.24pm that the vehicle had lost control and that the driver had suddenly become unconscious. Rescue crews found the man, surnamed Lam, still unconscious. He was taken to Yan Chai Hospital and was certified dead later in the afternoon. A woman in her fifties, reported to be the onboard attendant, sustained a minor hand injury and was also taken to hospital. All the children were checked and found uninjured.

The Transport Department briefly imposed two-way traffic in a single tube, causing congestion, before normal operations resumed at about 4.28pm. Police are investigating the cause of the accident. Reports said the driver had worked for the company for more than seven years and had undergone heart stent surgery several years earlier.

zh.headline: 城門隧道旅遊巴司機昏迷撞壆後不治 車上47名幼童無恙
zh.dek: 71歲男司機下午載學童由沙田往荃灣方向駛經城門隧道時突然失去知覺，旅遊巴撞向路壆，司機送院後不治，車上幼童全部無受傷。
body: 城門隧道周三下午發生交通意外，一輛載有47名幼童的旅遊巴在往荃灣方向管道內失控撞向路壆。71歲姓林男司機事發時突然昏迷，送往仁濟醫院後不治。
警方下午約3時24分接報，指有旅遊巴在沙田往荃灣方向管道失控撞壆，另有報案指司機突然暈倒失去意識。救援人員到場發現司機仍陷入昏迷，立即急救並送院，其後證實死亡。車上一名約50多歲女保姆手部輕傷，清醒送院；47名幼童經檢查全部無恙，其後轉乘另一輛旅遊巴離開。
運輸署一度實施單管雙程行車，交通擠塞，至下午4時28分取消措施。警方正調查意外成因。據悉涉事司機任職超過七年，數年前曾接受心臟通波仔手術。
